The Bangtan Archive

A chronological, fan-made archive of BTS’s musical history: group releases, solo work, pre-debut recordings, collaborations, covers, mixtapes, alternate versions, promotional tracks, and more.

Choose a year to explore releases and archive entries. Open any entry for artist credits, context, alternate versions, and available listening links. Early underground recordings may have uncertain dates or credits; unknown information is labelled rather than guessed.

Browse the years →

Research & official catalog links

Use these catalog hubs alongside the song-by-song platform searches. Official discographies and artist catalog pages were used to cross-check later releases and album tracklists.

BIGHIT MUSIC — BTS Discography ↗BTS Japan Official — Discography ↗BTS on Apple Music ↗BTS official music store — ARIRANG tracklist ↗BTS official accounts / SoundCloud ↗
